mechanism_of_action: Oral, liver-directed, thyroid hormone receptor beta-selective agonist.
primary_endpoint: At week 52: NASH resolution with no worsening of fibrosis, and fibrosis improvement by at least one stage with no worsening of the NAFLD activity score.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution: 25.9% (80 mg) and 29.9% (100 mg) vs 9.7% with placebo; fibrosis improvement: 24.2% and 25.9% vs 14.2%, respectively (P<0.001 for both doses vs placebo for both endpoints).
safety_signal: Diarrhea and nausea were more frequent with resmetirom than placebo. Serious adverse events occurred in 10.9% (80 mg), 12.7% (100 mg), and 11.5% (placebo).
